title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — Coverage Episodes per Resident
content:
**Rule.** Under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage, a resident may hold any number of Part A coverage episodes over time, one per skilled admission, but only one episode may be open at a time; an episode is open while its status is pending verification, active, notice issued or under appeal. A new episode is opened only when no other episode of the resident is open. A return to the center within the interrupted-stay window continues the open episode and opens nothing new; a return after that window opens a new episode once the earlier one has ended.

There is no maximum on the number of episodes a resident may hold over time; the only limit is one open episode at a time.

**Basis of judgement.** Whether another episode is open is read from the system record of the resident's coverage episodes and their statuses, never from the caller's account. The test is made per resident before an episode is opened.

| Status of the resident's other episode | Counts as open |
|---|---|
| Pending verification | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Notice issued | Yes |
| Under appeal | Yes |

| Situation (hypothetical) | Result |
|---|---|
| The resident's only other episode is under appeal | No new episode is opened |
| The resident returns within the interrupted-stay window | The open episode continues; nothing new is opened |
| The resident returns after the interrupted-stay window and the earlier episode has ended | A new episode is opened |
